versions.content: IdsM security event - SF error padding If frames with a payload <= 8 (either CAN 2.0 frames or small CAN FD frames) are used for a Rx N-SDU and CanTpRxPaddingActivation is equal to CANTP_ON and CanTp receives a SF Rx N-PDU belonging to that N-SDU, with a length smaller than eight bytes (i.e. PduInfoPtr.SduLength < 8), the CanTp module shall report the security event SEV_CAN_ERROR_PADDING.
